function.name: soccer_stats_get_last_match_result
function.description: Retrieve the results of the most recent match between two football teams. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team1.description: The name of the first team.

team2.description: The name of the second team.

season.description: The football season in question (Optional). Default: 'spring'

message.content: 我需要更多資訊才能幫您查詢。請問您想知道哪兩支球隊最近的比賽結果，還是想了解目前西甲聯賽中的所有球隊名單？如果是後者，抱歉目前我只能查詢兩支球隊之間的最近比賽結果。
message.reasoning:
The user asks in Chinese: "誰在西甲比賽？" which translates to "Who is playing in La Liga?" They want to know which teams are playing in La Liga. We need to retrieve the results of the most recent match between two football teams. But the question is ambiguous: "誰在西甲比賽？" could mean "Which teams are playing in La Liga?" or "Who is playing in La Liga?" They might want a list of teams currently in La Liga. But the tool only retrieves the result of the most recent match between two teams. There's no function to get all teams in La Liga. So we cannot answer directly. We can ask clarifying question: "請問您想知道哪兩支球隊最近的比賽結果嗎？" Or "請提供兩支球隊的名稱，我可以查詢最近的比賽結果。"

We should respond with a clarifying question.
